issues.description: The UML in the problem statement marks the Ride attributes as private ('-name: String', '-abbreviation: char'), but the solution declares the 'name' attribute as public in Ride (public String name). This is a visibility mismatch between the specification (UML) and the provided solution which can confuse students about the intended encapsulation and whether attributes should be declared private with public getters.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the 'name' attribute private to match the UML (change 'public String name;' to 'private String name;') and keep the public getter getName(). Update the template and solution code accordingly so the attribute visibility aligns with the specification and students are not confused about encapsulation expectations.
